title: Tide chart gifts
titleArt: Tide chart gifts and tide art prints
description: Gifts from Tide Hours, listed by kind and by town: {kinds}.
intro: Each one is made by Tide Hours. The tide gifts are drawn from the same tide predictions as this site: art, not for navigation, and not a NOAA product.
how: They are listed by kind, and by town within each kind. A town's name links to its tide times on this site, and each gift links to where it is sold, on {stores}.
families: Land and data prints on this page:

custom.heading: Custom tide chart prints
custom.text: A made-to-order print of the predicted tide at one place on one day, such as a wedding, a birth or the day you met, with a line of your own words. It is a digital file that you print. Order it in the

daylight.heading: Winter solstice print
daylight.text: The winter solstice in your city, December 21, {year}: the shortest day of the year, and the first bar on the page. After it come the 364 days to December 20, {next}, one thin bar for each, from midnight at the top to midnight at the bottom, so you can watch the light come back through spring to the long days of June and out again. Made to order as a digital file, for any city in the 50 states, Puerto Rico or the U.S. Virgin Islands; not interior or northern Alaska, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands or American Samoa.

sun.heading: Year-of-daylight prints
sun.text: The {year} hours of daylight in one city, day by day. They show the sun, not the tide.

sunrise.heading: Sunrise and sunset calendars
sunrise.text: The {year} sunrise and sunset times in one city, a month to a page. They show the sun, not the tide.

rings.heading: Tide rings art prints
rings.text: A town's whole {year} tide year drawn as rings, like the rings of a tree, one ring for each lunar month. A printable digital download.

posters.heading: Year-of-tides posters
posters.text: A whole {year} year of predicted highs and lows at one town on one sheet, a ribbon for each month. A printable digital download.

calendars.heading: Printable {year} tide calendars
calendars.text: Every predicted high and low tide of the year at one town, a month to a page, with the lowest tides of each month marked. Printable PDFs in US Letter and A4.

blanket.heading: Tide blanket patterns
blanket.text: A printable color chart for a knitted or crocheted {year} tide blanket: one row for each day of the year at one town, its color set by that day's tidal range, like a temperature blanket.

stitch.heading: Cross-stitch patterns
stitch.text: Full cross stitches only, 2 strands: no backstitch, no half or quarter stitches. No fabric, thread or kit is shipped. There are no month marks, times or heights on it: it is a picture of the year, not a calendar or a tide table.

book.heading: Printed tide tables
book.text: Tide tables printed and bound as a book, sold on Amazon.

moon.heading: Moon phase calendars
moon.text: The {year} phases of the moon, for the time zones each one names. They show the moon, not the tide.

sky.heading: Night sky prints
sky.text: The {year} night sky over one city. They show the sky, not the tide. Not a USNO or NASA product.

aurora.heading: Northern lights print
aurora.text: A year of geomagnetic storm days, from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center data. It shows space weather, not the tide. A storm day does not mean the aurora was seen anywhere in particular. A record of the past, not a forecast. Not a NOAA product.

river.heading: River year prints
river.text: Art from USGS daily streamflow data. They show a river, not the tide. Not a USGS product.

sealevel.heading: Sea level prints
sealevel.text: Art from NOAA tide station data. They show monthly mean sea level, not the tide. A picture of the record, not a chart for reading values. Not a NOAA product.

seatemp.heading: Sea temperature prints
seatemp.text: Art from NOAA National Data Buoy Center data. They show the temperature of the water, not the tide. Each shows what its station recorded in one year; it does not say what the water will be on any day to come. Not a NOAA product.

land.heading: Land prints
land.text: Art made from U.S. Geological Survey elevation data. They show the shape of the land, not the tide. Not a USGS product.

depth.heading: Above and Below prints
depth.text: Art made from U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA elevation and survey data. They show the shape of the land above the water and below it, not the tide. Not a USGS or NOAA product.

riverprofile.heading: River in Profile prints
riverprofile.text: Art made from NHDPlus river data, from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and the U.S. Geological Survey. They show the height of a river along its main stem, not the tide. Not a USGS or EPA product.

waterline.heading: Water Line prints
waterline.text: Art made from public lake-level data from the U.S. Geological Survey and the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation. They show a lake's surface elevation month by month, not the tide. Not a USGS or Bureau of Reclamation product.

snow.heading: Typical Year of Snow prints
snow.text: Art made from USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service SNOTEL data. They show the median snow water equivalent of each day at one measuring site over the 30 winters 1991 to 2020, not the tide. Not a forecast and not the snow of any one year. Not an NRCS product.

ice.heading: Ice Edge by Year print
ice.short: an Ice Edge by Year print
ice.text: Art made from U.S. Geological Survey glacier outlines and elevation data. It shows the edge of the ice as mapped in each year printed on it, not the tide. Not a USGS product.

normals.heading: Typical year prints
normals.text: A year of normal weather in one U.S. town, made to order from NOAA's 1991–2020 climate normals. They show the weather, not the tide. Not a forecast and not the weather of any single year. Not a NOAA product.
